candidates.name: Guidance for preparing plans for HM Land Registry applications
verified_facts: The guide says deed plans are an essential part of land-registration applications and that the title plan and register cannot describe land more accurately than the pre-registration deeds allow.
Plan quality and clarity are required for registration workflows.
semantic_limits: A compliant deed plan does not establish centimetre-level parcel survey accuracy or terrain elevation accuracy unless independent survey evidence supports it.

candidates.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 1 - basis of HM Land Registry plans
verified_facts: The guide states that Ordnance Survey mapping records topographic features and is not intended to represent property boundaries.
HM Land Registry uses Ordnance Survey MasterMap as a base for plans.
semantic_limits: Using MasterMap as a base does not make mapped feature lines legal title boundaries or measured elevation observations.
